purpose: Test the opportunity cost of reducing uncertainty outside monitoring-relevant geometric alternatives while wind still affects useful routes.
first_stage: One 32-second 3-D airflow pilot, 64x48x16 lattice, robot plane z=0.75 m; 16-32 s stationary vector mean. Wall-time cap 1800 seconds. No parameter sweep or interior field edits.
airflow_acceptance: Finite stable density/velocity using existing CFD gates
Stationary-mean sampling discrepancy reported, not hidden
Opposing wind changes central B-to-A transit with the existing force mapping
At least one alternative remains traversable with the same RPCBF
Remote-yard flow does not make baseline failure by collision the sole demonstration
physical_route_check: Compare central and alternative route execution before running complete learning missions. Same double integrator, actuator limits, tracking controller, wind-force law and RPCBF.
initial_information: Zero measurements, same POAM spatial prior everywhere; no true-wind support mask or observed-direction hints.
stopping: Same posterior vector RMS threshold 1.10 m/s, on each method's existing learning domain. No true-field RMSE gate.
equal_time: Baseline 4 learns globally then runs 300 simulated seconds of DA-MBD. Proposed runs for the same total elapsed time, including its learning stage.
metrics: Final clarity deficit at the same elapsed time
MBD-only median/p95/max planning time; compilation separate
Time and measurements in the eastern yard
failure_handling: Retain failed and learning-limit trials. Do not rerun or select seeds solely to obtain a winner. A proposed advantage remains a hypothesis until paired results exist.
compute: Geometry+mask measured separately. No larger grid, fewer wind worlds, reduced GP, modified force law or reduced MBD chain count to obtain favorable runtime. Full runtime must be measured.
